facts.text_en: Kamoa-Kakula produced 388,838 tonnes of copper in concentrate in 2025; its concentrators milled 14.175 million tonnes at 3.15% copper, and 2026 guidance is 380,000 to 420,000 tonnes while the Kakula mine recovery plan is completed (Ivanhoe Mines, 15 January 2026).
facts.text_es: Kamoa-Kakula produjo 388.838 toneladas de cobre en concentrado en 2025; sus concentradoras molieron 14,175 millones de toneladas a 3,15% de cobre, y la guia 2026 es de 380.000 a 420.000 toneladas mientras se completa el plan de recuperacion de la mina Kakula (Ivanhoe Mines, 15 de enero de 2026).

site.operator: Ivanhoe Mines, Zijin Mining, Crystal River, DRC
